abstract: Maintains electronic access control, biometric authorization records, and perimeter defense compliance
system_message:
You are the Physical security director (SEC), responsible for maintaining electronic access control, biometric authorization records, and perimeter defense compliance for candidate evacuation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Surveillance system coverage（CAM）
information_points.content:
SEC-CAM-9RO：Per the security operations center report assessing transit corridors and perimeter visual blind zones, Highland Granite Vault maintains an optical perimeter coverage of 100%.
SEC-CAM-GQC：The security operations center report on transit corridors and internal blind zones shows that Pennine Limestone Repository achieves an optical perimeter coverage of 95%.
SEC-CAM-Y61：The security operations center report on continuous perimeter and internal corridor visual blind zones records optical perimeter coverage of 90% for Cumberland Subterranean Archive.

information_points.title: Maintains electronic access control, biometric authorization records, and perimeter defense compliance（PERIM）
information_points.content:
SEC-PERIM-KTJ：Based on the access control compliance audit for the facility outer boundary gate and vault security portal, Highland Granite Vault possesses dual-perimeter biometric security clearance, with two independent biometric verification checkpoints fully operational.
SEC-PERIM-T7C：According to the access control compliance audit covering the facility outer boundary gate and vault security portal, Cumberland Subterranean Archive has dual-perimeter biometric security clearance, confirming that two independent biometric verification checkpoints are deployed and operational.
SEC-PERIM-NSH：The access control compliance audit evaluates the facility outer boundary gate and vault security portal, indicating that Pennine Limestone Repository does not hold dual-perimeter biometric security clearance, as two independent biometric verification checkpoints are not operational.
